fields.label: Business Name
fields.description: StartupOS instance name; the engine sanitizes it and rejects unsafe names

fields.label: Document Scope
fields.options:
Full Suite
Plan Chapters
Pitch Deck
Financial Model
Briefs
fields.description: Which deliverables this request records; the compiler always regenerates the whole suite (its output pruning depends on that)

fields.label: Questions File
fields.description: The executive's answered questions.md; copied to instances/business/<name>/questions.md at processing time. Leave empty when the workspace already holds the profile

fields.label: Workspace Root
fields.description: StartupOS workspace path on this bench; empty uses the engine's documented resolution order ($STARTUPOS_ROOT, .startupos.json, Frappe site path)

fields.label: Compliance Folder
fields.description: Optional path to the compliance evidence folder passed to the engine

fields.label: Render Binaries
fields.description: Also render the investor deck .pptx and financial model .xlsx; Pitch Deck / Financial Model scopes render regardless

fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Draft
Queued
Processing
Ready
Delivered
Failed

fields.label: Error Message
fields.description: Set only when status is Failed

fields.label: Warnings
fields.description: The engine's honest warnings verbatim, plus every unanswered question by its human label

fields.label: Completeness
fields.description: Answered fraction of questions.md reported by the engine (0-100)
